evidence.observedFact: The public events page lists recurring live-music nights and special dining events including a wine dinner, brunches, and an anniversary celebration, demonstrating an established event-driven customer-acquisition channel.

The public homepage invites satisfied guests to tell friends and family and to come back often; on the reviewed homepage and events page, no visible event-specific post-visit rewards, tracked referral, or repeat-visit retention mechanic is presented.

gaps.recommendedFix: Validate how event guests are currently retained, then demonstrate a permissioned post-event journey that converts event attendance into measurable return visits and referrals.
Validate whether referrals are currently tracked, then demonstrate a simple attributable referral loop that complements the restaurant's existing word-of-mouth invitation.

notes: The website supports the existence of recurring events and an explicit word-of-mouth/return invitation. Absence of a visible tracking mechanic on the reviewed pages is only a public sales hypothesis; confirm current CRM, loyalty, email, reservation, and referral processes with the merchant before claiming a gap or monetary value.
